_comment: Reusable media pool for video tools. Shot lists reference pool entries as media: 'pool:<tag>' (tag or name, case-insensitive, first match wins). The builder copies ONLY the used files into public/media-pool/ at build time, so the Remotion bundle stays small. Add entries here to grow the pool — drop the file in files/ and add a {name, file, tags} entry. Source of the seed entries: the GIFs used in Short #8 / Short #9 (Tenor), converted to MP4 (480px, 12fps) for motion in Remotion. Reuse judgement: same GIFs as the published Shorts.
